info.title: JioMeet User OAuth APIs
info.description: This section provides information about JioMeet's OAuth User APIs.These APIs can be utilized to seamlessly integrate JioMeet functionality into your backend systems.

get.summary: Scheduled Meeting - Fetch a scheduled meeting
get.description: This API fetches details of a scheduled meeting using the provided meetingId.  Required OAuth scope: `meeting:read` - To grant permission to read the scheduled meeting details

parameters.description: The content type should be application/json

jiomeetId.description: The unique identifier for the JioMeet session.

topic.description: The topic or title of the meeting.

startTime.description: The start time of the meeting in ISO format.

endTime.description: The end time of the meeting in ISO format.

scheduledDuration.description: The scheduled duration of the meeting in milliseconds.

meetingUrl.description: The URL to join the meeting.

status.description: The current status of the meeting.

pin.description: The PIN required to join the meeting room.

_id.description: The system-generated unique identifier for the meeting.

post.summary: Access Token Endpoint -fetch access and refresh token
post.description: This API acquires access and refresh tokens using valid credentials. Set the 'grant_type' parameter in the JSON request body as "authorization_code" for the authorization code flow or "refresh_token" for the token refresh flow.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: The content type should be application/json

grant_type.description: Specifies the grant type for the token endpoint, either "authorization_code" or "refresh_token".

code.description: - The authorization code token provided after the authorization request. - Include this only when grant_type is "authorization_code".

refresh_token.description: - The refresh token provided along with the original access token. - Include this only when grant_type is "refresh_token".

access_token.description: JWT token that can be sent to Jiomeet server to gain access to protected resources.

refresh_token.description: JWT token that can be used to obtain a new access token from Jiomeet server. Refresh tokens are used when the current access token becomes invalid or expires.

token_type.description: The type of token returned. In this case, it's a "Bearer" token, which means the token is used by appending it to a Bearer HTTP header.

expires_in.description: The expiration time of the access token. It tells the application when the token will expire so it can obtain a new one.

scope.description: Specifies the permissions that are granted to the access token. It defines the actions that can be performed with the token.

post.summary: Scheduled Meeting - Delete a scheduled meeting
post.description: This API deletes a scheduled meeting using the meetingId returned when the meeting was created.  Required OAuth scope: `meeting:delete` - To grant permission to delete the scheduled meeting.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: The content type should be application/json.

cancel.description: Specifies the scope of the deletion. Use 'current' to delete a specific scheduled meeting or the current instance of a recurring meeting. Use 'all' to delete the entire series of recurring meetings.

status.description: Message indicating the result of the delete operation.
